notes.title: Fretless - The Wrath of Riffson, release note for patch 3, build 19804628
notes.content:
[b]Fixed issues, new content[/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixed the passive of the RCA-TT-ACK monster
[*] Fixed descriptions for 8 String crescendo (from 20 damage per input to 2 damage per input)
[*] More fixes for battle not ending
[*] Fix for the Carbon Copy mod softlock if it tries to copy an empty slot
[*] Fix for fighting Oboe-A-Constrictor softlock when using Sapphire Skies Pedal
[*] Various English and French typo fixes
[*] Improved Rebinding on controller
[*] Added PS4 and PS5 controller support (need to disable steam input)
[*] Added Russian!
[/list]

[b]Known issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] KBM rebinding of QTE input still has issues (but can be worked around by closing and reopening the menu)
[*] Double KO with a boss can lead to missing riff visuals (relaunching the game solves it)
[*] The wolves cutscene can fail to end (relaunching the game solves it)
[*] The camera is misplaced when returning to Tonehenge after the bossfight
[/list]

[b]To report new issues:[/b]
If you’re facing any other issues, please report them here: 
[url=https://playdigious.helpshift.com/hc/en/31-fretless---the-wrath-of-riffson/contact-us/]https://playdigious.helpshift.com/hc/en/31-fretless---the-wrath-of-riffson/contact-us/[/url]

notes.title: The new demo is available now!
notes.content:
Our new demo is available now! 

Explore the first world of Fretless entirely in an updated demo! 
Venture into the new Dissonant Thicket area to encounter its boss, the vibrant Auxarachnid, waiting to catch you on its web. 
Hit the new rhythm-based QTEs in battle to maximize riff efficiency and beat your enemies with sick solos and crescendos! 
Customize your musical adventure with new mods to add to your instruments and new riffs to play on your bass and acoustic guitars!


NEW FEATURES: 

- New boss fight: cross riffs with the Auxarachnid in the Dissonant Thicket
- New QTE system: stay on the beat to out-solo your foes
- New riffs and mods to customize your adventure: add depth to your bass and swing to your acoustic guitar to beat musical monsters and goons
- New tutorialization: learn Fretless' mechanics and riff systems at your own pace, step by step. 

Get ready to rock this weekend! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44232724/cbc8726112b200bca0f81ba4df385a43b7bb5511.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo available: discover the world of Fretless during Save&Sound!
notes.content:
As you explore Fretless's melodious world for the first time, you'll be able to discover: 

- A musical turned-based combat system: arrange your favorite riffs and defeat your enemies with powerful crescendos
- Two different instruments to try out: whether you're an acoustic afficionado or a bass-slapping maniac, choose your own playstyle and mod your instruments to amplify your power
- Sick musical-monster hybrids: you already loved the percushrooms. Get ready to meet them for the first time! 
- A first boss encounter: SMR Larry is one of our personal favourites, and we're sure you'll understand why soon.

Come enjoy every musical element or wholesome encounter we sprinkled for your first adventure (and don't forget to give the dog some love!) 

Download the public demo today and wishlist the game to be notified at release next year! 

[previewyoutube=uUyWT_ZKeNg;full][/previewyoutube]


If you wanna know more about the game, make sure to follow our [url=https://tinyurl.com/475b32p8]newsletter[/url] and follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/Playdigious]Twitter[/url], [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@playdigiousoff]TikTok[/url] and [url=https://www.youtube.com/c/Playdigious]Youtube[/url].

Have a nice shredding!
